author: Adept478
title: The house always wins!!!
content:
Great games and definitely entertaining. However, when real money is involved, I’ve had some serious concerns about how the gambling side of the game works.

In the 1-vs-1 games, especially 8-ball, I’ve experienced matches that don’t start properly while my credits are still taken. I was then told that I would need to record each individual match myself in order to have a chance at getting a refund. That shouldn’t be the customer’s responsibility when the game fails to start.

I’ve also experienced some questionable ball physics toward the end of matches, with balls bouncing and moving in ways that don’t seem consistent with normal gameplay.

Another thing I’ve noticed is what appears to be a large number of accounts with very similar usernames/avatars, including names containing “_” and SpongeBob-style avatars, which makes the player pool feel questionable when money is on the line.

The games themselves are fun, but once gambling is involved, these issues become much more serious. Based on my experience, the gambling system does not feel transparent or trustworthy, and I believe the developers need to address these issues before players should feel comfortable putting real money into the game.
